result.summary: Evaluated screen layout for visual defects. Identified primary contrast accessibility issues on the promotional banner and minor text clipping on food item cards.

issues.description: White text on the light green promotional banner lacks sufficient color contrast, making header and subtext difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text colors or a higher-contrast background shade for the banner element.

issues.description: Restaurant label 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated at the right edge of the screen list.
issues.suggestion: Enable text wrapping or adjust card padding to display complete restaurant names.
